entities.name: L4 flexed right dysfunction
observations: The iliac crest landmark most commonly localizes to L4 or the L4-L5 interspace. A posterior right transverse process indicates right rotation; asymmetry worsened by extension indicates a flexed Type II lesion, with sidebending and rotation to the same side. The resulting diagnosis is L4 flexed, sidebent right, rotated right (L4 FRSR; option notation L4 FSRRR).
